results.snippet: See the Whats New Section. Remove the distutils package. See the migration guide for advice replacing the APIs it provided. The third-party Setuptools package continues to provide distutils, if you still require it in Python 3.12 and beyond
results.title: What to use instead of distutils in setup.py python3.12

results.snippet: Backwards Compatibility Code that imports distutils will no longer work from Python 3.12. The suggested migration path is to use the equivalent (though not identical) imports from setuptools (see [5]), or to migrate to an alternative build backend (see PEP 517).
results.title: PEP 632 - Deprecate distutils module | peps.python.org

results.snippet: According to PEP 632, distutils will be formally marked as deprecated, and in Python 3.12, it will be removed. My product is soon going to support Python 3.10 and I don't want to put up with deprecation warnings, so I would like to remove references to distutils now. However, I can't find clear documentation about how to do this properly.
results.title: How can one fully replace distutils, which is deprecated in 3.10?
